settings.title: Everything you need to know
settings.intro: Sizing, shipping, returns and more, answered straight, so you can shop with confidence.

settings.question: How do I know which size to pick? What if I’m between sizes?
settings.answer: Each product page has a size chart with bust, waist and hip measurements. Check it before ordering. If you are between sizes, we suggest going one size up for shapewear and bras, since our fabrics shape the body without compressing. Still unsure? Email info@nicshape.com with your measurements and we will recommend the best fit within 24 hours.

settings.question: Is Nicshape shapewear comfortable to wear all day?
settings.answer: Yes. Our pieces are made with breathable, stretch fabrics that move with your body, without rolling, pinching or digging in. Seamless construction and soft waistbands help everything stay in place, so you can wear them from morning to evening.

settings.question: Will it show under tight or thin clothing?
settings.answer: No. Bonded edges, invisible shaping panels and skin-tone color options are designed to disappear under fitted dresses, white tops and bodycon outfits. The fabric lies flat against the skin, with no visible lines, hooks or stitching.

settings.question: How long will my Nicshape pieces last?
settings.answer: Our products are made to last, with reinforced seams, quality elastics and shape-retaining fabric tested for repeated wear and washing. [OPTIONAL, ONLY IF YOU OFFER IT: Every piece bought directly from nicshape.com is also covered by our warranty against structural defects. If seams open or elastics fail under normal use, we will replace it or offer store credit.]

settings.question: How long does shipping take and where do you ship?
settings.answer: We ship worldwide. Standard delivery times are 5–7 days depending on the destination country. You will receive a tracking number by email as soon as your order leaves our warehouse. Full details are in our Shipping Policy.

settings.question: Will I have to pay customs duties, taxes, or VAT?
settings.answer: [KEEP ONLY IF TRUE: No. Orders ship DDP (Delivered Duty Paid), so we cover customs duties, import taxes and VAT. The price you see at checkout is the total you pay. If a carrier ever asks you for an unexpected payment, contact us right away and we will handle it.]

settings.question: What if it doesn’t fit or I don’t like it — can I return it?
settings.answer: Yes. You have 30 days from delivery to return a product that doesn’t meet your expectations. Items should be unworn, in original packaging and accompanied by your order number. Because our products are intimate apparel, items that have been worn beyond a brief try-on cannot be returned for hygiene reasons. Full conditions are in our Refund Policy.

settings.question: Can I exchange my product for a different size?
settings.answer: Absolutely, and your first size exchange is free. Email info@nicshape.com within 30 days with your order number and the size you want. Once we receive the original (unused, in original packaging), we will ship the new size at no extra cost. Later exchanges are at the customer’s expense.

settings.question: Do you offer a warranty if my product breaks or wears out?
settings.answer: [OPTIONAL, ONLY IF YOU OFFER IT: Yes. Nicshape offers a warranty on structural manufacturing defects, such as seams opening, elastics failing or material defects causing breakage. Send a photo of the defect and your order number to info@nicshape.com and we will respond within 14 business days with a replacement or equivalent store credit.]

settings.question: Is my payment secure and who do I contact if I need help?
settings.answer: All payments are processed through Shopify’s PCI-compliant secure checkout, and we never store your card details. [LIST THE PAYMENT METHODS YOU ENABLE.] For any question about your order status, sizing, returns or warranty, email info@nicshape.com. Our customer care team usually replies within 24 hours.

settings.title: Still have questions?
settings.text: Ask us on WhatsApp and we help you pick your size. We reply from 9am to 9pm.
